acceptance: SSB bundles exist at SF 0.1, 1.0, 10.0 on BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake (9 bundles); AMPLab at SF 0.1, 1.0 (6 bundles); JoinOrder at SF 1.0 (3 bundles); 18 bundles in total
The six Databricks bundles (SSB x3, AMPLab x2, JoinOrder x1) are rerun on current develop because the 2026-09-19/20 bundles lack the result-cache receipt the validator now requires

Each scale-invariant override (SSB SF 0.1 on BigQuery and Databricks, SF 10 on BigQuery and Databricks) and timing-plateau override (SSB SF 0.1 and SF 1.0 on BigQuery) is either cleared by a rerun or carries a maintainer-written reason
100% query pass rate across all runs, including all 113 JoinOrder queries translating and executing on each warehouse without dialect parse errors
All 18 result bundles pass scripts/validate_submission.py with 0 errors and carry result_source=internal
context:
JoinOrder tests deep optimizer join-enumeration with up to 16 joins per query, while SSB provides standard star-schema comparison against TPC-H. AMPLab stresses group-by and regex filtering performance.

Revalidated 2026-10-01. Query counts match the loaded classes (13 / 8 / 113) and the scales are within each benchmark's min_scale. On 2026-10-01 the validator passed all BigQuery and Snowflake bundles for these suites and failed all six Databricks bundles on the missing result-cache receipt. These suites are not rows of the 84-cell corpus campaign. Rerunning the six Databricks cells needs an approval that states command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition, and a check of the 500-table Unity Catalog quota first (the low-scale-factor SSB and AMPLab schemas were dropped to free quota). Overrides are maintainer decisions.

Delivered 2026-10-04. All 18 bundles are published and live:
- Snowflake SSB, and AMPLab and JoinOrder on BigQuery and Snowflake, in #2587.
- BigQuery SSB SF 0.1, 1 and 10 in #2602, with owner-approved timing-plateau (SF 0.1, SF 1) and scale-invariant (SF 0.1, SF 10) overrides.
- The six Databricks reruns (notuning, validated cache-off receipts) in #2615. They needed no overrides, and all 113 JoinOrder queries succeeded.
- published-results mirror #2620; site promotion run 37213072128.
See results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md "BigQuery SSB timing (2026-10-03)" and "Databricks cache-off reruns (2026-10-04)".

The unmet needs (tuning-no-midrun-destructive-db-handling-20261001, tuning-portable-metadata-store-20261001) gate tuned runs; every published run used --tuning notuning.
description:
Publish live cloud benchmark results across BigQuery, Databricks, and Snowflake for the Academic benchmark suites:
- SSB (Star Schema Benchmark): 13 star-schema queries (SF 0.1, 1.0, 10.0)
- AMPLab: 8 big data aggregation and scan queries (SF 0.1, 1.0)
- JoinOrder (JOB): 113 complex multi-way join queries on IMDB schema (SF 1.0)

Runs from 2026-09-19/20 already exist locally for every cell but none is published. Under the current validator the Databricks bundles fail and several BigQuery bundles need overrides (see acceptance).
Verify all bundles pass benchbox.validation.bundle.validate_bundles and scripts/validate_submission.py.
